summary_en: 370,000 shares (5.0% of S/O), ¥130M upper limit, ToSTNeT-3 buy, price ceiling ¥321/share (prior-day close), settlement 2026-08-17. Cancellation to follow on 2026-08-31 (combined with 77 treasury shares held). Controlling shareholder (CEO Hiroshi Yamamoto) expected to participate as seller; transaction approved by independent committee and non-interested directors.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Market Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-14, Atlas Technologies' board authorized a single-day block purchase of up to 370,000 shares (5.0% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥130M via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading on 2026-08-17 at 08:45 JST, using the prior close price of ¥321/share. The controlling shareholder, CEO Hiroshi Yamamoto, is expected to participate as a seller. The transaction has been structured to protect minority shareholders: it uses market-based pricing (the prior day's closing price), is executed through ToSTNeT-3 (which offers equal terms to all sellers), and was reviewed by an independent special committee and approved by non-interested directors. The acquired shares will be cancelled on 2026-08-31 along with 77 treasury shares then held. The stated rationale is capital strategy for FY2026 (ending Dec 2026), specifically to maximize total shareholder value through dynamic capital returns, improve capital efficiency, and increase the proportion of shares in free float.
